image_title: Comparison of Max Utility Achieved Over Time
summary: This line chart illustrates the comparison of maximum utility achieved over time between two groups: LLM-based and Template-based interfaces. The x-axis represents time in minutes, ranging from 0 to 15, while the y-axis indicates max utility, with values from 0 to 27. The LLM-based group is depicted with a solid line, while the Template-based group is represented with a different line. The chart includes shaded areas indicating ±1 standard deviation for both groups. The data shows a gradual increase in utility over time, with the LLM-based group consistently achieving higher utility compared to the Template-based group. The source of the data is attributed to G. Fouilhé et al.
